sources.name: SIRUTA_s1 2026 — Registrul unităților administrativ-teritoriale ale României
sources.purpose: Canonical legal identity, hierarchy and UAT type for Romania reconciliation
sources.reconciliation_policy: Prefer explicit SIRUTA codes. Otherwise accept only exact normalized UAT name plus exact county; fuzzy matches never auto-assign legal identity or type. OSM remains geometry/provenance, SIRUTA remains legal identity/status.

sources.name: Clasificatorul unităților administrativ-teritoriale (CUATM)
sources.authority: Biroul Național de Statistică al Republicii Moldova
sources.purpose: Canonical reconciliation source for Moldovan administrative-territorial units and localities
sources.latest_verified_update: BNS Ordinul nr. 106 din 17.10.2025; electronic CUATM updated accordingly
sources.reconciliation_policy: Explicit CUATM identifiers are candidates until verified against the downloaded official snapshot; exact normalized name + parent may be reviewed; fuzzy matches never auto-assign legal type.

policy: OSM tags describe imported geometry and mapping conventions. Legal administrative type is assigned only where an official source or an explicit official reconciliation key supports it.
